free_tier.stated: Free and open source at USD 0 a month with unlimited executions when self-hosted; Enterprise Self-Host from USD 120 a month. The hosted Community plan is dev-services/windmill-cloud

tooling: the user installs and runs the Windmill server and worker containers and a Postgres database, with Docker Compose on one machine or the Helm chart on Kubernetes, on a rented or free machine

limits.value: 'Unlimited executions' on the self-hosted open-source tier; Enterprise Self-Host from $120/mo

limits_note: The free self-hosted edition caps an instance at 3 workspaces, 50 users, 10 users with SSO, a 10 GiB workspace object storage quota, job run details kept up to 30 days and 100 trigger emails a day; executions are unlimited.

identity_cost.detail: No account with Windmill is needed: the documented install downloads docker-compose.yml, Caddyfile and .env from raw.githubusercontent.com and runs docker compose up, and the first login is on the user's own instance.

confidence_note: the pricing page was read on 2026-10-22. 'Unlimited executions' is a claim about a missing limit, so it is recorded as the unit unlimited and not multiplied into a capacity figure
